message: Thanks, a couple of answers weren't clear. Including you and your dad, how many people live in your household? And roughly how much does the household earn from work in a year, before tax (for example $20,000 to $30,000, $30,000 to $40,000)?

summary: Mississippi household, likely 2 people (respondent plus 72-year-old dad, though respondent said "just me"). No kids, no disability, employer insurance, about $9,600/yr other income, about $34,800 in assets, no Social Security reported. Earned income was never stated ("we do okay"). The household probably has too much income and too many assets for most programmes, and the employer coverage rules out the ACA credit. No programme is clearly recommended, so I'm handing off to a caseworker to confirm household size and income.
